# Project Design Context

Maintained for the Astro v7 editorial research magazine and refreshed with
`pnpm run design:refresh` when the component system changes.

## Project

- Name: instarlab-website
- Product type: Editorial research magazine
- Stack: astro, tailwind-v4, vite
- Color mode: light
- Density: airy

## Sources

- Tokens: `src/styles/tokens.css`
- Components: `src/components/chrome`, `src/components/primitives`
- Assets: None detected
- Instructions: CLAUDE.md
- Component workflow: `.21st/COMPONENT-WORKFLOW.md`

## Components

- Installed: None detected
- Preferred primitives: None detected

## Tokens

- Canvas: `#ffffff`; ink: `#1b1b1b`; brand: `#1072ba`; deep brand: `#0d5d98`
- Display: Raleway; body: Roboto; UI: Lato
- Gutter: `clamp(1rem, 2.6vw, 2.25rem)`; panel radius: `0.75rem`
- Motion: Motion for progressive reveals; reduced motion is required

## Constraints

### Must

- Semantic HTML with one main and one primary h1
- Keyboard-visible focus and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Preserve approved nonprofit facts and AVIF-first media policy
- Keep WebGL optional and below the fold

### Avoid

- Duplicated navigation or footer markup
- Opaque client-side rendering for editorial content
- Fabricated facts or unlicensed creative assets
- Large above-the-fold JavaScript bundles

## Decisions

- Tailwind CSS 4 is integrated with `@tailwindcss/vite`.
- Motion is used for progressive reveals; Three.js is lazy-loaded only for
  the research constellation.
- 21st.dev is a component registry/reference workflow; copied components
  must live in `src/components`, be adapted to Astro-native static HTML, and
  meet the project quality contract in `.21st/COMPONENT-WORKFLOW.md`.
